AKM .366 (Slugs).info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM ammunition.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are soft point rounds.

RM277 8.6BLK Conversion.info:
Converts your RM 277 to fire the subsonic 8.6mm Blackout cartridge!
This quieter cartridge fully hides you from the radar while increasing your ranged damage!
Very low bullet speed with weaker damage up close while also reducing penetration and firerate somewhat.

SCAR PDW 7.62 Conversion.info:
Swaps your MK16 SOCOM CQB receiver for the one of the MK17 SOCOM, effectively making it a MK17 PDW!

Very high damage - especially in close range - but suffers somewhat from the reduced magazine capacity of 10 and relatively unstable recoil.

e Shotgun Heavy Discs.info: Improves the spread with heavier 'pancakes', with stronger suppression. Range is more evenly spread. Bullets drop faster.

AEK 556 Conversion.info:
Converts your AEK-971 to fire 5.56x45mm turning it into the AEK-972!
Improved range damage while slightly lowering accuracy and damage up close.

S-12U 953 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12U with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
 Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

DBV .410 Conversion.info:
A conversion kit for the .410 shotgun round using a modified trigger group designed to fire in two-round bursts.

Reduced pellet count, but with increased damage per pellet, magazine capacity, and overall rate of fire.

FBI 10 TOMMY.info:
Change the internals of your Thompson with those of the specialized FBI variant that fired 10mm Auto.
Turn the criminal's own weapon against them, with rounds kick like a mule!

PARA 5.56 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into 5.56x45mm NATO.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.
Comes Packed with standard issue 30-round STANAG Magazinse.

105 5.56 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your AK105 into 5.56x45mm NATO using a slightly modified 35-round magazine.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.

ECR 5.56 Conversion.info:
The most common ammo type found in the warzone. Why you're putting it in a rifle designed for 12.7x42mm is beyond mortal understanding.
Expect unforeseen consequences...

S-12U 223 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12U with .223 Remington.
 Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

BIZON 7.62 Conversion.info:
Loads your PP-19 BIZON with 7.62x25mm.
 Smaller magazine, but more power and more motherland!

Redhawk 45 Colt.info: Convert your Redhawk 44 into a Redhawk 45, making it fire the 45 colt cartridge in single action! It will become much stronger in close range, but be slower and hampered at longer ranges.

SCAR PDW 9mm Conversion.info:
Converts your MK16 SOCOM CQB into a true PDW by letting it fire 9x19mm using a conversion kit by Big Woods MFG.
Higher fire rate, close up damage and lower recoil, but lowers ranged damage, penetration and bullet speed.
Retains light weight and quick reload speed!

TCR 5.56 Conversion.info:
The most common ammo type found in the warzone. Why you're putting it in a rifle designed for 12.7x42mm is beyond mortal understanding.
Perfect for getting that civilian firearm feeling!

MOSIN 410.info:
You won't believe what Zarovian farmers are doing this time!
Convert your worn out MOSIN MAGANT into a modern day FROLOVKA that fires 410 bore rounds!

KOV 7.62 Conversion.info:
Load your Krinkov with 7.62x39mm.
 Expect the damage of your firearm to improve greatly with a little added range too. Controlling it might be a problem.

AR 7.62x39 Conversion.info: A high-precision rifle round designed to give the AR-15 platform performance somewhat comparable to 7.62x51mm, but with around half of the recoil impulse. The larger bullet is still able to load into the AR-15's magazines, but with a lower maximum capacity.

AUG 9MM Conversion.info:
Converts your UAR A1 into the F88T training rifle using .22 LR!
Low damage to non-headshots while significantly lowering recoil, reload time and quicker handling.

S-12 9MM Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12 with 9x19mm.
Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

G36 .300 Conversion.info:
Load your STG-91 with .300 Blackout.
Making it the civilian variant with a full-semi trigger group. It offers greater close range performance, worse long range. Great with suppressors!

FAL .45 Conversion.info:
Converts your FAL 50.00 to fire .45 ACP from an aftermarket modified Thompson 50 round drum magazine!
Slow bullet speed and fast range dropoff, but powerful up close and surprisingly still deals decent ranged damage. Slower reload time and handling!

G3 .45 ACP Conversion.info:
Convert your STG-59H into .45 Super.
Changing the weapon to feed from Thompson magazines this conversion can also function with the CETME Model 58 due to it and the STG-59H's similarities. Feels like using a full size battle rifle, but in a PDW-type package.

7.62x39 Blanks.info: Instead of regular 5.56x45mm blanks, load your AR-15 magazine with 7.62x39mm blank rounds! These being larger cartridges means you will propel your projectile further than 5.56x45mm, you also get greater ranges. However, there is the smaller magazine to tend to.
